# AI Guardians Avatar Pack

> Versioned runtime media for AI Guardians motion portraits and speech-mouth overlays.

This pack hosts production portrait and overlay assets for the game. Published version directories are immutable. These proprietary assets are published solely for AI Guardians runtime delivery; publication grants no reuse, redistribution, modification or relicensing rights.

## Game

- [AI Guardians](https://www.aiguardians.games/): The main game website.

- [Avatar pack documentation](https://github.com/NellInc/ai-guardians-avatar-pack/blob/main/README.md): Version history, asset scope, integrity checks and rights.
